title: Disentangling objects' contextual associations from perceptual and conceptual attributes using time-resolved neural decoding
description: Raw 128-channel EEG data from 20 observers viewing object images in a rapid presentation paradigm, together with representational dissimilarity matrices. The dataset supports time-resolved neural decoding analyses that separate objects' contextual associations from their perceptual and conceptual attributes. One participant was excluded because of a technical recording error, leaving 19 usable participants.
methods_description: 128-channel EEG was recorded from 20 observers viewing object images at a rate of 3.33 Hz (image duration 100 ms, ISI 200 ms). One participant (sub-02) was excluded due to a technical error in the EEG recording, leaving a final sample of 19.
